plugins.name: context-handoff
plugins.description: Past a context threshold, writes a handoff and a conversation inventory, compacts, and hands them back with the next message.

plugins.name: agent-deck
plugins.description: A live side panel of the session's subagents and a progress bar above the prompt. Inspired by savvy-progress by JohnnyVizz.

plugins.name: cache-clock
plugins.description: A pill above the prompt that says whether the prompt cache is warm or cold, counts down to cold, and pings to keep it warm.
